license.title: OpenRx License
license.subtitle: Choose the plan that fits your practice. All plans include offline validation and automatic updates.
license.noLicenseMsg: Enter your license key below or choose a plan to get started.

faq.a1: Each license key is tied to a specific tier and duration. The key is validated offline using HMAC-SHA256 — no internet required after activation.
faq.a2: Yes! Simply activate a new license key for your desired tier. The new plan takes effect immediately.
faq.q3: What happens when my license expires?
faq.a3: You'll see a warning banner 7 days before expiry. After expiration, some features may be limited until you renew.
faq.a4: Absolutely. Your clinical data is never shared. The license only controls feature access — all patient data stays on your servers.
